claims.source: BeerCrank + About Beer Magazine + Untappd voice (3.5, ~52k ratings)
claims.note: THE FACTOR-COLLAPSE CASE, resolved correctly by disaggregation: venue/experience elite, beer competent-but-contested. Should rank TOP for a first-timer/tour/experience query and MID for 'best pilsner' — Godspeed's Czech lagers outrank it there on juried + editorial voice. Ground truth agrees (go-for: pilsner; not-for: experimental). Negative side now verbatim from a dedicated critical review.

lines: Steam Whistle Pilsner tends to appeal primarily to drinkers who favor mild, neutral beers. The beer lacks the depth and complexity found in many modern craft or European pilsners, leaving a somewhat one-dimensional taste.
